toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: indoor navigation with UHF.
#
# Building entry loss grows with frequency, and modern thermally efficient buildings
# (metallised glass, foil-backed insulation) add far more than traditional ones. The
# campaign composes two `leo-pass` runs of one generic low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite
# passing 60 deg over a user inside a building in Rome, in the UHF, L, S and C bands, one
# per ITU-R P.2109 building class (median loss, 50 % probability), and records the peak
# carrier-to-noise density (C/N0) of each band.
#
# UHF keeps the highest indoor C/N0 in both buildings and is the only band above a
# 25 dB-Hz tracking threshold in the traditional one (about 34 dB-Hz, against 24 for L,
# 16 for S and 9 for C). The thermally efficient building takes every band below it, UHF
# least (about 15 dB-Hz). The two members differ only in the building class.
#
# MODELLED: ITU-R P.2109-2 building entry loss (VALIDATED against the ITU workbook) on
# representative EIRPs; no indoor multipath or fading beyond the P.2109 statistics.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Indoor LEO-PNT by band and building class"
seed = 20260929

[[compose.members]]
label = "traditional-building"
metrics = [
  { name = "uhf_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[0].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "l_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[1].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "s_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[2].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "c_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[3].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
]
[compose.members.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
epoch = "2026-09-28T12:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[compose.members.scenario.user]
environment = "indoor"
lat_deg = 41.9
lon_deg = 12.49
height_m = 50.0
building_probability = 0.5
antenna = "hemispherical"
gain_dbi = 0.0
polarisation = "linear"
building = "traditional"
[[compose.members.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["UHF", "L", "S", "C"]
max_elevation_deg = 60.0
tca_s = 450.0
[compose.members.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"

[[compose.members]]
label = "thermally-efficient-building"
metrics = [
  { name = "uhf_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[0].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "l_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[1].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "s_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[2].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "c_peak_cn0", path = "satellites[0].bands[3].peak_cn0_dbhz" },
]
[compose.members.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
epoch = "2026-09-28T12:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0
[compose.members.scenario.user]
environment = "indoor"
lat_deg = 41.9
lon_deg = 12.49
height_m = 50.0
building_probability = 0.5
antenna = "hemispherical"
gain_dbi = 0.0
polarisation = "linear"
building = "thermally-efficient"
[[compose.members.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["UHF", "L", "S", "C"]
max_elevation_deg = 60.0
tca_s = 450.0
[compose.members.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"
